name: FerMINI
summary: FerMINI is a named millicharged-particle experiment proposal with candidate sites in the Fermilab MINOS or DUNE near-detector halls, Illinois. The sites remain candidates rather than a falsely asserted selected location.
detection_principle: A movable multilayer coincidence-scintillator detector downstream of a proton fixed target would test MeV–GeV small-charge particles through weak ionization and timing/directional correlations.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
